datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a monthly schedule across Niger in 2014, classifying geographic areas into food insecurity phases. The data represents near-term projections of acute food insecurity conditions, with multiple scenarios captured for January, April, July, and October 2014.
